title: WashU announces new academic-industry collaboration with Bristol Myers Squibb
summary_en: WashU and Bristol Myers Squibb have formed a multiyear collaboration to advance drug development projects in the neurosciences. WashU medical and research trainees will have opportunities to work alongside the company’s scientists at its facilities as part of the agreement.
title_cn: WashU announces new academic-industry collaboration with Bristol Myers Squibb

title: Lessons from the wild
summary_en: Plant scientists at WashU organize research on wild plant diseases that could help agricultural systems endure climate change.
